info.title: Label_Switch_Path
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

l2_service.description:
Reference Resource: [VLAN](#/VLAN)
Reference to VLAN Table this service represents. This value is valid only when we have l2_service being carried. This value is applicable when the type is 'l2-vpn' service type.

l3_service.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
Reference to VRF Table this service represents. This value is valid only when we have l3_service being carried. This value is applicable when the type is 'l3-vpn' service type.

label_endpoints.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Endpoint](#/Label_Endpoint)
Provides the allocated Label Endpoints 'entry': indicates Label Endpoint associated for Entry LSP 'transit': indicates Label Endpoint associated for Transit LSP

label_switch_paths.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch_Path](#/Label_Switch_Path)
In case of service Label Switch Path, this indicates the lower level Label Switch Path for transporting the service to its service peer.

lsp_egress_attributes.description: MPLS attributes that will be used in configuing the transit or egress label bindings.

dscp_mapping_table_id.description: The table ID used for obtatining the DSCP re-map for transit MPLS bindings.

exp_mapping_table_id.description: The table ID used for obtatining the EXP re-map for transit MPLS bindings.

inherit_exp_from_dscp.description: Indicates whether EXP value can be inherited from DSCP values of native packet.

inherit_exp_from_pcp.description: Indicates whether EXP value can be inherited from PCP values native packet.

inherit_ttl.description: Indicates whether TTL value can be inherited from incomig label or native packet.

insert_entropy_on_entry.description: Indicates whether Entropy labels need to inserted for egress traffic.

use_dscp_mapping_table.description: Indicates whether whether to use the DSCP mapping table for this entry MPLS bindings.

use_exp_mapping_table.description: Indicates whether whether to use the EXP mapping table for this transit MPLS bindings.

nexthop_ip.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch_Path](#/Label_Switch_Path)
IPv4 or IPv6 nexthop ip address for the Label Switch Path.

out_label.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch_Path](#/Label_Switch_Path)
Indicates the outgoing label for the Label Switch Path.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Outgoing port associated with the Label Switch Path. This will be populated in the case of transport Label Switch Path to indicate the outgoing L3 interface the defines the local nexthop.

prefix.description: IPv4 destination prefix and mask in the address/mask format. Example 192.168.0.0/16 IPv6 destination prefix and mask in the address/mask format. Example 2001:0DB8:0000:000b::/64

service_label_entry.description:
Reference Resource: [Service_Label](#/Service_Label)
Reference to Service Label Table for platforms that abstract the service into Service table in the dataplane.

source.description: Indicates the source protocol for the Label Switch Path. LDP - Label Distribution Protocol BGP - Border Gateway Protocol static - Static LSP system - Built-in (system defined)

state.description: The state for the Label_Switch_Path entry

type.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch_Path](#/Label_Switch_Path)
Type of Label Switch Path 'transport' : Indicates the Label Switch is used for transport 'l3-vpn' : Indicates that the Label Switch Path carries l3-vpn service 'l2-vpn' : Indicates that the Label Switch Path carries l2-vpn service

vpn_label_endpoints.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Endpoint](#/Label_Endpoint)
In case of L3VPN Label Switch Path, this is the list of entry label_endpoints which can be used by Routes for egress.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
